Possible Cause:
Serial link cable may be
defective
Corrective action:
Check the serial link cable
between low power
unit(MB2) and Tx(MB2)
should be connected
properly and check the
continuity.

Faults:
Tx(MB2) related Jam
On LED not blinking
during jamming
Corrective action:
Check all the commands are
given properly.

Possible Cause:
JAM INIT switch might
be not pressed
Corrective action:
Check HV ON command of
Tx(MB2) and Jam Init switch
is pressed

Check the functionality of 6-
18 GHz DTO

Faults:
Link failure between
EAP and HB
Jammer
Corrective action:
Observe any faults reported
at LCU like TEMP and
FLOW errors. TEMP OK
and FLOW OK are the inter
lock to enable the power
supplies.

Check ETH SW2 and its
connections

Faults:
Tracking issue
during Track and
JAM command in
case of Deception
Jamming Technique
and Spot Technique
Possible Cause:
Track could be passive
on SCD
Corrective action:
For a given track and JAM
command for a particular
intercepted track on SCD,
observe the Track should be
in Active condition during
Track and Jam command.

Possible Cause:
Any obstruction to the
receiving Antennae.
Corrective action:
Check there is no
obstruction on RX antenna
such that all the time RF
illumination should be on Rx
